name: API Toolkit Examples
description: Demonstration CRUD API endpoints built with the features of the API Toolkit module.
project_description: API Toolkit Examples is the demonstration submodule of API Toolkit. On install it creates an 'example_page' node type (with a link field and a self-referencing 'similar pages' entity-reference field), inserts two sample nodes, and registers five working CRUD endpoints under /api/example-pages that show how to combine API Toolkit's request classes, standardised responses (including paged and cacheable variants) and custom entity/field normalizers. It exists purely as reference code and is not intended for production use; its routes are deliberately open (access control is out of scope for the examples).
